settings.question_1: What makes tallow different from regular moisturizers?
settings.answer_1: Grass-fed beef tallow is the closest match to your skin's natural sebum. Unlike synthetic moisturizers that sit on top of skin, tallow absorbs deeply, delivering fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, and K directly into your skin cells.
settings.question_2: Is this safe for sensitive skin?
settings.answer_2: Absolutely. Our tallow creams contain only 5 ingredients — all organic, all natural. No synthetic fragrances, no preservatives, no chemicals. Tallow's biocompatibility makes it one of the gentlest moisturizers available.
settings.question_3: How is this different from the other scent varieties?
settings.answer_3: All three varieties share the same nourishing tallow base with organic olive oil and jojoba oil. The only difference is the essential oil blend — choose the aromatherapy experience that fits your mood and routine.
settings.question_4: How should I store this product?
settings.answer_4: Store in a cool location away from direct sunlight. Tallow melts at 85°F — if melted, oils may separate. Gently mix and refrigerate if necessary. This is normal and does not affect product quality.
settings.answer_5: All orders ship free within the US. Orders are processed within 1-2 business days. We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee — if you're not satisfied, contact us for a full refund.

settings.question: What is tallow and why is it good for skin?
settings.answer: Tallow is rendered fat from grass-fed cattle. It's rich in vitamins A, D, E, and K, and its fatty acid profile closely mirrors human skin's natural oils, making it deeply nourishing and easily absorbed.

settings.question: Are your products tested on animals?
settings.answer: Never. All Leaf & Bird products are cruelty-free. We believe in clean beauty that's kind to both your skin and the planet.

settings.question: Do you offer international shipping?

settings.question: How long will one jar last?
settings.answer: A little goes a long way. Most customers find that one jar lasts 6-8 weeks with daily use. Our tallow cream is highly concentrated, so you only need a small amount per application.
